name: NEGATIVE CONTROL — a bundle that dropped its DEBUG round-trip
why: The failure R15 exists for, and the only one the journal can see that the bundle cannot hide. The milestone agent hit a red suite, went to DEBUG, fixed it and came back green — and wrote all of that down as it happened, because a journal line is appended on every node exit. Then the bundle came back describing one clean pass through TEST. Every other check is satisfied: the shas are real, the suite is green NOW, the branch is right, the observations are non-empty. Only the journal disagrees, and only in one direction: it saw work the trace does not contain. Without R15 this run records a milestone that never struggled, spends none of its TEST budget on a retry it actually took, and leaves the ledger and the auditor with nothing to notice.

because: the journal recorded DEBUG finishing, and the trace never leaves it
a retry the counter never charged

journal.headline: The first milestone agent for this milestone never returned a bundle. milestone agents['1'] was open with no history entries after it — the death signature — so before…

steps.observation: The first milestone agent for this milestone never returned a bundle. milestone agents['1'] was open with no history entries after it — the death signature — so before re-spawning I ran git log a1b2c3d..PROJ-1/simulated: no commits, the milestone agent died before it wrote anything. Re-spawned once; the branch already existed and was reused.

journal.headline: holistic review clean; suite green after

steps.observation: Holistic pass clean, suite re-run by me green. Milestone agent 1's replay is finished, so its entry is cleared — a milestone agents key with no transitions and no blocked is the halt signature, and leaving it set would fake one.
